set: B: one sheet of each acting state the page uses, plain, nervous, shocked, confident, scared and exhausted, with no time and no word on it

issues.where: all twelve frames, arrow inside the ball
issues.what: the arrow holds one static upright pose across the whole sheet while the ball and background move; it slides along like a pointer with no tumble, lean, or reaction, so no feeling is readable at a glance
issues.fix: rotate and lean the arrow with the ball's roll, and give it a visible reaction when the track turns or the scene changes

issues.where: frames 2 through 9 on the spiral chute
issues.what: the ball corkscrews down the coil but the arrow stays upright and unchanged in frame after frame, reading as glued in place rather than riding or tumbling; no stretch during the fast descent
issues.fix: tumble the arrow as the ball spirals and stretch it along the direction of travel in the fastest drops

issues.where: frames 2 through 8, then the final funnel frames
issues.what: seven frames hover with no change in pose or feeling and no wind-up as the funnel appears; the fall at the end has no anticipation or alarm before it happens
issues.fix: add a lean-back or alarm beat as the funnel opens (compressed, tilted away, shadow tightening) so the fall reads as a reaction

issues.where: frames after each flipper hit, rows 1, 3 and 4
issues.what: the ball is clearly struck and rolls, but the arrow inside does not squash or jolt on impact and stays rigid and upright in several post-hit frames, so the hits don't register on the character
issues.fix: squash the arrow against the side of the ball on each impact and let it rebound with a short overshoot

issues.what: the stapler arm and coils visibly hit and squeeze the ball, but the arrow keeps constant size and shape; there is good tumbling yet no squash on contact, so impacts feel slightly weightless
issues.fix: add a one-to-two frame squash on each contact and a stretch in the fastest motion-blur frames

issues.where: bottom row, arrow in the glass pipe
issues.what: the tumbled pose is readable but small; at delivery size the arrow inside the reflective ball and pipe gets lost against the metal highlights for a beat
issues.fix: thicken the arrow's black outline and rim-light the ball so the silhouette stays readable in the pipe

issues.what: did not read: nervous reads as frightened and overwhelmed by what the port does to it. Beads of sweat, the small tremble and the gulp are not in the read.
issues.fix: Nervous as the kit has it, seen before the port takes it and in the ball: sweat that forms and rolls off, a tremble, a gulp down the body, at a size at which they show.

issues.what: did not read: scared reads as calm and passive, riding upright and reacting to nothing. Pale and stony, the lean back and the hiding are not in the read.
issues.fix: Scared as the kit has it, seen in the ball on the way up the lane: the arrow gone pale and stiff and leaning back from where the ball is going.

issues.what: did not read: shocked reads as panicked and jostled, which is what the bumpers and the stapler do to the ball. The double take, the stretch tall and the snap back are not in the read.
issues.fix: The double take of Shocked as a held pose after a hit: the stretch tall, then the snap back, clear of the next hit.

issues.what: did not read: confident reads as tense but mostly passive. Upright with a slight bounce and a strut is not in the read.
issues.fix: Confidence in the body on the rail: upright in the glass, a bounce with the ride, held where the camera is close.

issues.what: did not read: exhausted reads as dazed and batted around. The sag, the melt at the edges and the slump are not in the read.
issues.fix: Exhausted as the kit has it: the arrow sagging and slumped against the inside of the glass, held after the last hits.

reads.read: drifting idly with no clear feeling for most of the sheet; a metal funnel opens beside it and, caught off guard at the very end, it tips and topples in
frightened and overwhelmed; swallowed by the metal bowl, sealed into a clear bubble, tumbled around, then flushed down a glass pipe and carried away
calm and passive; carried along an elevated conveyor track inside its ball, just riding upright as the city of tracks scrolls past, not reacting to anything
panicked and jostled; bounced between big glowing coils on a desk and struck by a swinging stapler arm while trapped in the ball
tense but mostly passive; riding its ball down a tall spiral coil chute, staying upright instead of tumbling as the world spirals
dazed, being batted around like a pinball; struck by orange flippers and rolled past warning lights and a background-check machine
